name: One real production turn and bind only the new native spy identity

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_BIND_SPY' then error(b.lastAction) end; return b.retryProductionStatus=='PRODUCTION_PENDING' or Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY')~=nil

steps.code: local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_SPY_RETRY'); if not r.spyID then return 'PRODUCTION_PENDING' end; local s=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.ReadEnemy(); assert(r.spyID~=r.archive.spyID and s.spy and s.spy.present and s.spy.id==r.spyID,'new native spy binding missing'); return 'NEW_SPY_BOUND'
